rules.description: Apron: allow WebSocket handshakes and connection status probes
rules.expression: (http.host eq "server.apron.chat") and (http.request.method ne "GET" or not http.request.uri.path in {"/" "/ws"} or (not any(lower(http.request.headers["upgrade"][*])[*] eq "websocket") and not any(http.request.uri.args["apron_connection_status"][*] eq "1")))

rules.description: Optional: limits / and /ws across ALL hostnames in the zone
